Description

heart of West London. Designed to accommodate both 5-a-side and 7-a-side formats, the pitch provides the perfect setting for competitive fixtures, team training sessions, corporate matches, or casual games with friends. As a fully enclosed indoor facility, it allows you to play comfortably all year round, whatever the weather.

Players can enjoy clean and well-maintained on-site showers and toilet facilities, along with convenient changing areas that ensure a comfortable experience before and after every match. The venue is available for both single bookings and block bookings, making it ideal whether you are organising a one-off game or securing a regular weekly slot for your team.

Conveniently located just a short walk from West Acton Station, the pitch is easily accessible by public transport, offering a prime location for teams across London.

Enquire today to secure your booking and experience one of West London’s newest indoor football facilities.
